Clear blue sky above, dark green water reflecting the single bridge opening and parts of the trees. Midday sunlight, realistic ordinary colors, crisp stone texture, no people, vehicles, buildings, signs or extra bridges. View from the canal bank with the canal leading upward from the foreground and the complete bridge inside the image. Vertical 4:5 image, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. Full coherent composition, no text, logos, watermark or frame. Do not apply infrared coloring or surreal effects to this source image.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source for image verification: one canal leads from the lower foreground toward one stone footbridge in the middle distance. samplePrompt: Create an original natural color overhead photograph of exactly three separate botanical specimens lying on plain pale linen: one long fern frond at left angled upward, one single fan-shaped ginkgo leaf at upper right, and one eucalyptus twig with several attached rounded leaves at lower right. Leave visible linen gaps between all three specimens. Gentle daylight from the upper-left produces small realistic contact shadows. Fresh natural green foliage, detailed veins and a neutral linen weave, ordinary photographic exposure and color. The complete fern tip, all stems and the full fabric surface remain inside the composition. No vase, hands, labels, notebook, decorative objects or loose extra leaves. Vertical 4:5 image, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. No lettering, logo, watermark, border or stylized blue tint; this is an unprocessed source photograph.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source for image verification: a top-down view contains three separate specimens on one pale linen surface. A long feather-shaped fern lies at left, one fan-shaped ginkgo leaf lies at upper right, and one short eucalyptus twig with attached round leaves lies at lower right. Negative linen space separates the specimens. Preserve each stem attachment, fern leaflet arrangement, ginkgo fan outline and existing contact-shadow direction; do not interpret attached leaves as new separate specimens.

Deliver only the finished edge-to-edge artwork, without comparison panels, mockups, frames, labels, lettering, logos, signatures or watermarks.

acceptanceZh: 整体明亮通透，衣物、皮肤和天空仍有细节。
每个人的身份、肤色、肢体和相对位置不变。
轻雾随距离增加，不覆盖脸部或切断轮廓。
背景结构保留，没有磨皮、光晕或全白替换。
acceptanceEn: The image feels bright and airy while clothing, skin and sky retain detail.
Every person's identity, skin color, anatomy and relative position remain unchanged.
Haze increases gently with distance without covering faces or breaking contours.
Background structures remain, without beauty smoothing, glow halos or white replacement scenery.
geometryNoteZh: 高调不是擦除阴影和背景；必须保留相邻人物的间距、四肢边界、物体支撑点及原始景深层次。
geometryNoteEn: High-key rendering must retain body spacing, limb boundaries, object support points and background depth instead of erasing shadows and scenery.

summaryZh: 让折射聚焦形成的细碎水光落在现有表面，明暗网纹随曲面轻轻转折，保留食物与器物的自然色泽和真实形体。
summaryEn: Project restrained refracted-water light onto existing surfaces, letting narrow luminous networks follow real contours while preserving natural materials and colors.
sampleTitleEn: Three Peaches in a White Bowl
samplePrompt: Create an original natural color food photograph of exactly three ripe peaches in one shallow matte white ceramic bowl on a pale stone tabletop. Two peaches sit toward the front and one behind, each visibly separate with natural pink-yellow skin and fine fuzz. One clear straight-sided drinking glass half-filled with water stands at upper right outside the bowl, leaving a visible gap. Soft daylight from upper left, normal photographic illumination without dramatic water reflections, gentle contact shadows, plain pale wall in the background. Three-quarter view from slightly above, entire bowl and glass visible, no cut fruit, leaves, utensils, hands or additional dishes. Vertical 4:5 image, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. Realistic source photograph, full coherent composition, no lettering, brands, watermark, frame or stylized effects.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source for image verification: one shallow elliptical white bowl occupies lower-middle frame and contains exactly three whole peaches, two in front and one behind. One half-filled cylindrical glass stands separately at upper right. The waterline is horizontal within the glass; the stone table and pale wall form the background. Preserve peach count, overlap order, bowl rim ellipse, glass walls, waterline and contact-shadow placement.
mediumAnchor: Natural photographic lighting with restrained refractive water caustics projected onto existing surfaces, not a liquid or glass material transformation.

fragments.text: Keep a natural photograph and introduce subtle refractive water caustics as illumination on existing surfaces, never as newly added objects.
Project sparse branching bands of concentrated light from a coherent direction; follow surface curvature and let existing occluders interrupt the pattern.
Retain the source's natural material colors; allow pale cool highlights and softly warm ambient shadows without a blue underwater wash.
Make light bands irregular, narrow and softly graded; avoid uniform geometric grids, painted white veins or hard luminous outlines.
Preserve skin, fruit fuzz, ceramic grain and fabric beneath the light; matte surfaces must stay matte and dry.
Keep all subjects, containers, openings and positions unchanged; add no pool, water sheet, droplets, glass layer or reflected duplicate objects.
Keep caustics sparse near faces and identifying details; retain readable highlights, real cast shadows and existing transparent-water boundaries.
Balance the light pattern below the subject's visual priority; preserve photographic exposure without glitter, neon glow, borders or overlays.

preserve: Exact subject, food and container counts
Natural material identity, color and dry surfaces
Source geometry, overlaps and liquid boundaries
Readable identifying details and coherent cast shadows
negative: added droplets, pool or duplicate reflections
sparkle filter, border, lettering or watermark
acceptanceZh: 焦散是表面照明变化，不是增加水池或液体材质。
光网随曲率和遮挡变化，没有整图平铺。
主体数量、器物边界、原有水位与材质不变。
高光不过曝，主体仍为视觉重点，无霓虹描边。
acceptanceEn: Caustics change surface illumination without adding pools or turning materials into liquid.
Light networks follow curvature and occlusion instead of tiling across the whole image.
Subject counts, container boundaries, existing water levels and materials remain unchanged.
Highlights stay controlled and the subject remains primary, without neon outlines.
geometryNoteZh: 焦散纹样可以沿现有曲面弯折，但不得改变碗口、玻璃边界和食物形状，也不得生成新的水面或倒影主体。
geometryNoteEn: Caustic patterns may bend across existing surfaces but must not alter rims, glass boundaries or food shapes, or introduce new water planes and reflected subjects.

summaryZh: 保留一个清楚的主体，在确有运动方向的局部叠入少量递减曝光残影，像频闪记录动作节奏，不复制成多人或新增肢体。
summaryEn: Keep one clear subject and add a few fading exposure traces only along plausible moving parts, recording motion rhythm without cloning people or inventing anatomy.
sampleTitleEn: One Sweeping Gesture against a Gray Wall
samplePrompt: Create an original natural color full-body photograph of exactly one adult dancer against a plain gray rehearsal-room wall and matte gray floor. The dancer wears a plain muted teal long-sleeve shirt, dark trousers and simple white shoes. Their torso is upright, left arm relaxed downward, right arm extended diagonally toward image right at shoulder height with an open relaxed hand. Both feet are visible, one firmly planted and the other slightly behind with its heel raised, suggesting the end of a gentle arm sweep. Show one clear sharp body and one clear face, ordinary soft side lighting from image left, realistic anatomy, contemporary documentary photography. Leave generous empty space to the right of the extended arm, and keep all fingertips and shoes inside frame. Vertical 4:5 image, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. No mirrors, other people, props, motion blur, repeated limbs, text, logos, watermark or borders in this source image.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source for image verification: exactly one full-body dancer stands near center-left, with one upright torso and one face. The left arm hangs downward; the right arm extends diagonally right at approximately shoulder height. Two feet remain visible, one planted and one slightly back with its heel raised. Empty wall space extends to the right of the hand. Preserve the single person, head, torso, two-arm anatomy, planted contact point and clothing; any later motion traces must be faint exposures tied only to the moving right arm.
mediumAnchor: A photographic stroboscopic motion study with one dominant sharp subject and sparse fading exposure traces confined to a plausible movement path.

fragments.text: Render a stroboscopic motion photograph with exactly one dominant sharp subject and faint sequential exposure traces of plausible moving parts only.
Keep the source body, face, object counts and camera position unchanged; anchor every trace to the same subject and movement path.
Add at most two or three thin fading contour echoes behind the moving edge; never create complete duplicate bodies or detached limbs.
Let successive exposure traces decrease in brightness away from the sharp final position, with one consistent directional motion rhythm.
Preserve subdued source colors and use translucent traces derived from the moving material, avoiding rainbow splitting or neon streaks.
Keep the primary face, clothing and stationary background crisp; motion traces remain transparent photographic exposure, not opaque painted repetitions.
Protect facial identity and planted contact points; if motion is ambiguous, use one minimal edge trail rather than inventing an action.
Retain the original crop and readable anatomy; omit speed graphics, detached hands, mirrored clones, timestamps and decorative frames.

preserve: Exactly one dominant instance of each original subject
Facial identity, primary body anatomy and clothing
Stationary contact points, environment and camera perspective
Original crop and physically plausible movement direction
negative: detached hands or new opaque limbs
speed lines, timestamps, lettering, border or watermark
acceptanceZh: 原有主体数量不变，始终只有一个占主导的清晰人像。
最多两到三道透明残影沿合理方向递减。
残影局限于运动部位，不生成完整分身、独立手掌或新肢体。
脸部、落脚点和背景稳定，原始构图与裁切保留。
acceptanceEn: Original subject counts remain unchanged, with one dominant clear image of each person.
At most two or three transparent traces fade along a plausible direction.
Traces stay on moving regions without creating whole clones, detached hands or new limbs.
Faces, planted contact points and background stay stable, preserving the original composition and crop.
geometryNoteZh: 唯一允许的几何外延是运动边缘的低透明度曝光轨迹；主像人体结构不变，不复制头部、躯干或完整人物。
geometryNoteEn: Only low-opacity exposure trails may extend beyond moving edges; preserve the primary anatomy without duplicating heads, torsos or complete people.
